scope: Six balanced rounds per case across current main, integrated candidate, and historical da84. Current main is the primary acceptance baseline; da84 is a historical source/build reference. Whole normal JIT/AOT process wall and in-process loop wall are separate; outside_loop_s includes frontend, LLVM, initialization and teardown, not pure compiler startup. All elapsed observations are new on this Intel host; historical elapsed series are not pooled. Current main and candidate tool profiles are newly measured; only the historical da84 profiles may be reused after exact input/runtime/tool/module validation. Profile observations are separately instrumented and not elapsed acceptance.
